_comment: THE curated Picks list of the Resource Pack Hub (Will, 2026-11-03). Edit this file, then run
`python tools/packs/verify_picks.py --write` to regenerate PackPicks.java in every module;
CI (.github/workflows/pack-picks.yml) verifies every entry against the live sources.
source: modrinth = installed through Modrinth (project id + uploader pinned);
direct   = the creator's own file, only where their terms allow automated downloads,
SHA-256 + size pinned (a different file is refused);
link     = 'Open page' only: terms forbid automated downloads (PvPRP) or the file sits
behind an ad / subscribe gate (MediaFire) or is built on a site (Vanilla Tweaks).
versions: exact game versions the pick really supports ('auto' = take Modrinth's file list; the
verify run writes the real list into picks.verified.json).
copies: Modrinth project ids of other people's re-uploads of this pack (hidden in Browse).
Only originals uploaded by their creator; candidates whose uploader isn't the creator are left out.
